newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Directors' trading referred to ASC - Auspine.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Directors' trading referred to ASC - Auspine.

text.p: Timber group Auspine Ltd said on Monday that it had referred complaints about share trading by managing director Adrian de Bruin and director Keith Veall to the Australian Securities Commission (ASC).
In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange, Auspine said the ASC had not yet advised the company of the outcome of its consideration of the matter.

The company said it had received complaints earlier this year regarding share trading by De Bruin and Veall and, following investigation of the circumstances surrounding the complaints, the board had resolved to refer the matter to the
ASC on a strictly confidential basis.

Auspine said it had not concluded that any unlawful conduct had taken place but the board considered it was unable to deal further with the matter and that it was appropriate to refer to the matter to the ASC, so that the ASC could consider the matter and decide what steps if any the ASC wished to take.

Former director Ron Bassett said in the statement that he had resigned after finding his position untenable following significant delays in de Bruin and Veall submitting satisfactory responses to the board sub-committee dealing with the share trading issue.
At midday, Auspine shares were 31 cents lower at A$3.00 on turnover of 30,445 shares.
